comment_regular: Apply NiStencilProperty to DX9 render state: stencil enable/ops/function/reference/mask plus D3DRS_CULLMODE selected from the native face-draw-mode table. Mode-5 caster pass groups later disable stencil but retain this property-driven cull mode.
comment_repeatable:
Apply NiStencilProperty to DX9 render state: stencil enable/ops/function/reference/mask plus D3DRS_CULLMODE selected from the native face-draw-mode table. Mode-5 caster pass groups later disable stencil but retain this property-driven cull mode.
DX11 verified ordered writes: enabled flags bit0 => RS52=1, RS56 from manager+9C+4*(flags>>12), RS57 property+1C, RS58 property+20, RS53/54/55 from manager+BC indexed by flag fields1..3,4..6,7..9. Disabled writes only RS52=0. Always RS22 from manager+D4+4*(2*((flags>>10)&3)+DWORD(manager+F4)); +F4 is projection flip index. Other stencil states remain inherited.
